    ```ts
    import * as result from 'true-myth/result';
    ```

  [Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<T, void, undefined> {

      let done = false;
      return {
        next: () => {
          if (done) {
            return { done: true, value: undefined };
          }
          done = true;
          return { done: false, value };
        },
      } as Iterator<T, void, undefined>;
    }
    return {
      next: () => ({ done: true, value: undefined }),
    } as Iterator<T, void, undefined>;

    ```ts
    import * as result from 'true-myth/result';

    const [oks, errs] = result.partition(okResult);

    const errResult = result.err('error');
    const [oks2, errs2] = result.partition(errResult);
    console.log(oks2); // []
    ```

  partition(): [T[] | never, E[] | never] {

    }
